name: jeyas installed extensions exporter
author: Jeyas

sections.description:
jeyas installed extensions exporter helps site administrators review extensions installed on a WordPress website by exporting extension details to a CSV file.

Features

  • Export installed extensions to a CSV file.
  • Include extension names and version numbers.
  • Show whether each extension is active or inactive.
  • Include plugin file information where available.
  • Open the exported CSV file in Microsoft Excel or compatible spreadsheet software.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP file through the WordPress admin dashboard, or upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate jeyas installed extensions exporter from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open the plugin’s administration page.
  4. Use the export option to download the CSV file.
sections.faq:
What file format is exported?

The plugin exports a CSV file, which can be opened with Microsoft Exceland other spreadsheet applications.

Does the export change my installed extensions?

No. The export is intended to report extension information and does not activate, deactivate, install, or remove extensions.

Who can use the exporter?

Access is controlled by the plugin’s WordPress administration permissions.
